remarks: Welcome to 59 Emerald Lane, a beautifully updated home tucked on a private cul-de-sac just off Newfield Avenue, directly across from King School. Meticulously improved inside and out, this residence blends classic architectural detail with modern systems and elevated finishes for a level of quality that is truly hard to find. At the heart of the home, the chef's kitchen features high end appliances and flows seamlessly into the family room, creating an easy, everyday layout that also shines for entertaining. Natural light fills the spaces throughout, giving the home a bright, airy feel you will notice the moment you walk in. Step outside to the patio and enjoy a smooth indoor-outdoor connection that makes the setting feel even more special. Every corner of 59 Emerald Lane has been thoughtfully enhanced from top to bottom, resulting in a home defined by premium materials, upgraded infrastructure, architectural charm, and long term durability. This is a standout offering in the Newfield area, reflecting consistent investment, pride of ownership, and a commitment to excellence.
